insecure_http_model_hosts.description: Hosts trusted for credential-free HTTP model forwarding through NeMo Relay >=0.11.0; no schemes, ports, paths, wildcards, brackets, or zone identifiers.

max_budget_usd.description: Maximum amount in US dollars that Claude may spend during one invocation.

max_buffer_size.description: Size limit the Claude Agent SDK applies to one JSON message from Claude Code. Omit to use the SDK default.

reasoning_effort.description: Claude reasoning effort. Omit to preserve the harness default.

approval_mode.description: Codex approval handling mode for escalated permission requests.

config_overrides.description: Dotted Codex configuration keys mapped to JSON-compatible values.

developer_instructions.description: Additional developer instructions for the Codex thread.

insecure_http_model_hosts.description: Hosts trusted for credential-free HTTP model forwarding through NeMo Relay >=0.11.0; no schemes, ports, paths, wildcards, brackets, or zone identifiers.

output_schema.description: JSON Schema that constrains the final assistant message for each turn.

reasoning_effort.description: Codex reasoning effort for each turn.

service_tier.description: Codex service tier for the thread.

capabilities.description: Capabilities granted to the plugin, such as tools.override, written to plugins.entries.<id>.granted_capabilities. Hermes ignores ids it doesn't know.

config.description: The plugin's own settings, written to plugins.entries.<id>.settings.

enabled.description: Turn the plugin on or off. true makes start fail unless Hermes loads it.

auxiliary.description: Native Hermes auxiliary-task controls written to config.yaml for every execution path. Only authored fields are written.

enabled.description: Whether Hermes starts automatic background memory and skill reviews after turns. Explicit native /refine remains available. When omitted, Hermes's default applies.
Whether Hermes generates session titles automatically. When omitted, Relay-enabled runtimes disable it and other runtimes keep Hermes's default.

interfaces.description: Native interfaces served by the runtime as child processes.

api.description: Hermes's API server, run by a gateway child. After every enabled interface starts, the adapter writes its bearer token to interfaces/api.token in the Hermes home: <artifact root>/.fabric/hermes/runtimes/<runtime-id>, or the agent's state folder with runtime.keep_state.

enabled.description: Serve Hermes's OpenAI-compatible API server. A present api interface is on unless this is false.

port.description: Exact loopback port for the API server. Start fails if it is in use.

dashboard.description: Hermes's dashboard, which has no sign-in when bound to loopback. It needs a built frontend at HERMES_WEB_DIST.

enabled.description: Serve Hermes's dashboard and browser chat. A present dashboard is on unless this is false.

port.description: Exact loopback port for the dashboard. Start fails if it is in use.

terminal.description: Experimental terminal attachment to a managed TUI backend. Uses headless serve without dashboard assets, or shares the dashboard process. The configuration (including terminal.port), interfaces/tui.json, interfaces/tui.token, and the nemo_fabric_adapters.hermes.terminal helper may change across releases as the #579 launcher contract is adopted; compatibility is not guaranteed for these surfaces.

port.description: Experimental TUI backend loopback port. Must match dashboard.port when both interfaces are enabled. This required field may be removed when the #579 launcher contract is adopted.

max_tokens.description: Maximum number of tokens in each Hermes model response.

plugins.description: Hermes plugins, translated to Hermes's native plugins section in config.yaml. A plugin id may appear in only one section. The other fields are Hermes's own plugin controls and are written as they are. Plugins the agent installs itself are not supported.

auto_apply.description: Whether the update check applies Git plugin updates unattended. Hermes's default is false.

auto_update_check_hours.description: Hours between read-only plugin update checks; 0 disables them. Hermes's default is 24.

entries.description: Plugins that ship with Hermes, keyed by plugin key or name, such as security-guidance or browser/firecrawl. enabled: true makes start fail unless Hermes loads the plugin; enabled: false turns off one Hermes loads by default. Start fails if the plugin doesn't ship with Hermes.

clone_timeout_seconds.description: Seconds for one plugin Git clone, fetch, or checkout. Hermes's default is 300.

external.description: Plugins with user-prepared code and dependencies.

entries.description: Plugins from those folders, keyed by manifest name. A path alone doesn't enable a plugin; with enabled set to true, start fails unless Hermes loads it.

paths.description: Plugin folders, each holding plugin.yaml and the plugin's code, such as plugins mounted on a volume. The adapter links each into the Hermes home's plugins folder under its manifest name at start and unlinks it at stop. Relative paths resolve against the NeMo Fabric base directory; start fails if one doesn't exist. Python dependencies must already be importable.

hook_callback_timeout.description: Seconds for one in-process plugin hook callback; 0 means no cap. Hermes's default is 30.

launcher.description: Command prefix the plugin host runs under, such as a sandbox runner.

isolation.description: Run third-party Python plugins inside Hermes or in Hermes's plugin-host process. Hermes's default is in_process.

load_timeout_seconds.description: Seconds for one plugin's import and registration at load; 0 means no deadline. Hermes's default is 10.

plugins_enabled.description: Hermes plugin keys or names to turn on; prefer plugins.bundled or plugins.external. Start fails when an identifier is absent or did not load.

enabled.description: Whether Hermes model reasoning is enabled.

save_trajectories.description: Whether Hermes saves its native conversation trajectories as JSONL.

sdk.description: Embedded SDK execution, enabled by default. Runtime management remains available when disabled.

enabled.description: Initialize the embedded SDK agent during startup. Disable for native-only execution; SDK invocation then fails explicitly.

startup_timeout_seconds.description: Time from the start of the runtime for every enabled interface to pass its health check, within NeMo Fabric's 90-second start limit.

terminal_timeout.description: Maximum number of seconds for a Hermes terminal operation.

tools.description: Native Hermes tools section written to config.yaml. Distinct from NeMo Fabric's normalized top-level tools.enabled and tools.blocked. Only authored fields are written.

enabled.description: Hermes tool search: auto, on, or off; true and false are native aliases for on and off. off presents the selected tool schemas directly. When omitted, Hermes's default applies.

duplicates.native: Two different skills with the same name in skills.external_dirs are refused as ambiguous; a skill in the Hermes home, bundled or agent-created, outranks external_dirs.

config_schema.description: The local_shell backend requires an explicit tools.enabled allowlist (including an empty list) or execute in tools.blocked.

description.description: Description the main agent uses to select this asynchronous subagent.

graph_id.description: Graph or assistant identifier on the Agent Protocol server.

headers.description: Additional string-valued HTTP headers sent to the Agent Protocol server.

name.description: Unique asynchronous subagent identifier exposed to the main agent.

url.description: Optional Agent Protocol server URL; omit it to use the SDK's default endpoint.

description.description: Description the main agent uses to select this subagent.

interrupt_on.description: Subagent-specific tool interrupt policy; the main agent policy is inherited when omitted.

model.description: Optional provider:model override; the main agent model is inherited when omitted.

name.description: Unique subagent identifier exposed to the main agent.

response_format.description: JSON Schema for this subagent's structured response.

skills.description: Skill source paths loaded only for this subagent.

allowed_decisions.description: Human decisions allowed for this tool call.

args_schema.description: JSON Schema for editable tool arguments.

description.description: Static description shown with the approval request.

deepagents.description: JSON-serializable adapter and Deep Agents options.

backend.description: Optional backend selection. Local shell execution runs directly on the adapter host without process isolation.

interrupt_on.description: Mapping of Deep Agents tool names to human-in-the-loop interrupt policies; omitted tools run without an interrupt.

middleware.description: Custom LangChain middleware for the main agent, applied in list order before NeMo Fabric's tool policy and telemetry middleware.

ref.description: Import path of an installed LangChain AgentMiddleware subclass, as package.module:Class.

settings.description: Keyword arguments passed to the middleware class constructor.

subagents.description: Caller-defined declarative or asynchronous subagents; the built-in general-purpose subagent remains available by default.

reasoning_effort.description: Reasoning effort passed to ChatOpenAI. Requires an OpenAI-compatible provider; omit to preserve the model default.

duplicates.native: Each entry is a Deep Agents skills source and the later source wins, so the copy from the later entry loads.

kind.description: A tool implemented in an installed Python package.

ref.description: Import path of a LangChain BaseTool instance or BaseTool subclass, as package.module:attribute.

settings.description: Keyword arguments passed to a BaseTool subclass constructor; must be empty for a BaseTool instance.

cost_tracking.description: Use strict SDK pricing, or explicitly disable monetary budgeting for unpriced models. Disabled requires a positive runtime.max_turns; cost remains unavailable.

timeout.description: Maximum duration of one shell command.

config_schema.description: The shared NOOA adapter requires a registered workflow target.

api.description: OpenClaw's request adapter for the custom provider at base_url, written as models.providers.<provider>.api. Requires base_url; when omitted, the custom provider uses openai-completions.

supports_usage_in_streaming.description: Whether the configured custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint supports stream_options.include_usage. Requires base_url; omitted values retain OpenClaw capability detection.

config.description: The plugin's own configuration, checked by OpenClaw against the plugin's schema.

enabled.description: Turn the plugin on or off. true makes start fail unless OpenClaw loads it.

agent_id.description: OpenClaw agent selected for SDK invocations and managed native clients.

agents.description: Native OpenClaw agents.defaults controls for NeMo Fabric-owned Gateways. Only authored fields are written; attached Gateways reject them.

enabled.description: Whether OpenClaw runs its pre-compaction memory flush turn. This does not stop compaction itself.

every.description: Native recurring heartbeat interval, such as 30m or 1h30m. Units are required; 0m disables the recurring cadence but not event-driven turns.

channel_config.description: OpenClaw-native channels and bindings for NeMo Fabric-owned services. Every binding must target the configured agent. Managed runtimes reject channel configuration.

connect_timeout_seconds.description: Timeout for connecting to the local OpenClaw Gateway.

interfaces.description: Native interfaces served by a managed runtime. Services reject interfaces.

dashboard.description: OpenClaw's Control UI. After the Gateway starts, the adapter writes its sign-in token to <state_dir>/interfaces/dashboard.token with runtime.keep_state, or <artifact root>/.fabric/openclaw/runtimes/<runtime-id>/interfaces/dashboard.token for ephemeral state.

enabled.description: Serve the Control UI. A present dashboard is on unless this is false.

port.description: Exact loopback Gateway base port, which serves the Control UI. Start fails if it or port + 2 is in use. OpenClaw allocates browser ports through port + 110 on demand, so keep that range free. Can't be combined with port_range.

public_origins.description: Additional browser HTTP(S) origins. OpenClaw also permits loopback origins; the token is always required.

terminal.description: Attach the native terminal to the existing Gateway. No terminal port; publishes a private executable launcher and terminal.running marker.

openclaw_command.description: OpenClaw executable name or path. Relative paths containing a directory are resolved from the NeMo Fabric base directory.

plugins.description: OpenClaw plugins for NeMo Fabric-owned Gateways, translated to OpenClaw's native plugins section. A plugin id may appear in only one section, and fabric-shared-config is reserved for the adapter. Attached Gateways reject plugin settings.

entries.description: Plugins that ship with OpenClaw, keyed by plugin id. With enabled set to true, start fails unless OpenClaw loads the plugin.

enabled.description: Whether the memory-core plugin runs scheduled dreaming.

external.description: Plugins with user-prepared code and dependencies.

entries.description: Plugins from those folders, keyed by plugin id. A path alone doesn't enable a plugin; with enabled set to true, start fails unless OpenClaw loads it.

paths.description: Plugin folders OpenClaw loads, each with its built code and node_modules, such as plugins mounted on a volume. Relative paths are resolved from the NeMo Fabric base directory; start fails if one doesn't exist.

port_range.description: Inclusive consumer-allocated port range. The adapter selects a Gateway base port whose complete derived footprint through base + 110 fits within the range. When omitted, the adapter selects an available local range.

read_timeout_seconds.description: Timeout between response bytes from the local OpenClaw Gateway. When unset, the invocation timeout bounds the response.

shutdown_timeout_seconds.description: Maximum graceful Gateway shutdown time before forced termination. NeMo Fabric allows 30 seconds for the complete adapter stop. Leave time for cleanup within that limit.

startup_timeout_seconds.description: One deadline for all of start, from checking the OpenClaw command to the Gateway becoming ready, within NeMo Fabric's 90-second start limit.

tools.description: Native OpenClaw tools controls for NeMo Fabric-owned Gateways, merged with the allow and deny lists generated from NeMo Fabric's normalized top-level tools. Only authored fields are written; attached Gateways reject them.

codeMode.description: Whether OpenClaw Code Mode is enabled. Code Mode can take precedence over tool search.

notifyOnExit.description: Whether OpenClaw emits a system event and heartbeat when a backgrounded exec process exits.

toolSearch.description: Whether OpenClaw compacts large tool catalogs behind search tools.

allowIpv6UniqueLocalRange.description: Whether web_fetch, image, and pdf may connect to addresses in fc00::/7. Set it only behind a fake-IP proxy that owns that range and enforces its own destination policy.

allowRfc2544BenchmarkRange.description: Whether web_fetch, image, and pdf may connect to addresses in 198.18.0.0/15. Set it only behind a fake-IP proxy that owns that range and enforces its own destination policy.

duplicates.native: A higher OpenClaw source wins: workspace skills, then state-folder skills, then shipped skills, then skills.directories. Between skills.directories entries the later entry wins.

scope_reasons.description: Bounded reasons invocation ownership or completion could not be proved; contains no native messages, commands, or credentials.

insecure_http_model_hosts.description: Explicitly trusted HTTP model endpoint hostnames, without schemes, ports, paths, or wildcards.

model.description: Pi-specific catalog metadata for a model Pi does not already ship natively. `api` is the model's wire protocol and must be supplied for an unknown (gateway-served) model; when omitted Pi inherits a built-in model's native api.

api.description: The wire protocol Pi uses to talk to this model.

cost.description: Per-million-token pricing. All four rates are required and non-negative.

insecure_http_model_hosts.description: Hosts trusted for credential-free HTTP model forwarding through NeMo Relay >=0.11.0; no schemes, ports, paths, wildcards, brackets, or zone identifiers.

relay_extension_path.description: Absolute path or environment.workspace-relative path to the NeMo Relay Pi extension matching the CLI release

base_url.description: Remote agent API root, including the /v1 path segment.

connect_timeout_seconds.description: Timeout in seconds for connecting to the remote agent.

read_timeout_seconds.description: Timeout in seconds between response bytes from the remote agent.

relay_streaming.description: Whether the remote service accepts NeMo Fabric request correlation metadata and publishes ATOF to the configured Relay stream sink.
